battle.name: 薩克森戰爭
battle.theater: 下薩克森埃姆斯河谷與威悉河畔
battle.brief: 772年起，查理曼以改宗與納貢為名，三十年間九度進入下薩克森，鎮壓維杜金德率領的反抗，直至803年維杜金德歸順。戰事沿埃姆斯河與威悉河反覆拉鋸，薩克森憑森林、沼澤與村落堡壘遲滯法蘭克騎兵。卡面秦連弩於西歐當時並無實物，其位置實際由弓箭、飛斧與盾牆承擔。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰方分兩邊：法蘭克王國，與西北德意志的薩克森聯盟。法蘭克方面是加洛林王室的直屬王軍加邊疆伯爵體系，軍隊由查理曼直接統率，並靠威悉河、埃姆斯河與阿勒河下游的堡壘線、由伯爵常駐的要塞、附庸體系與傳教士網絡維持對新併地帶的控制；士兵來自法蘭克、洛林、勃艮第、阿拉曼尼亞與薩克森本身的徵召名冊，作戰以步兵盾牆、重裝騎兵與投石手混編，糧秣靠牛車與徵發。薩克森方面不是國家，而是三個相鄰部族拼成的鬆散聯盟，核心地帶是威悉河與埃姆斯河之間的沼澤、森林和村落地帶，首領為世襲的部落貴族，平時以村社武裝自守，戰時才由一位流亡首領統合。制度與信仰差異同樣是戰爭內涵：法蘭克已納入拉丁基督教的主教與修道院網絡，薩克森仍維持舊神祭祀中心與地方祭司，宗教爭端從一開始就是法蘭克開戰的藉口之一。
countriesEn: There were two sides: the Frankish kingdom and a loose Saxon confederation in north-western Germany. On the Frankish side stood the Carolingian royal host under direct command of Charlemagne, reinforced by margrave counts, hereditary strongholds and dependent lords along the Weser, the Ems and the lower Aller, and by a network of missionaries that held the newly annexed districts in place; the troops were levied from Frankish, Rhenish, Burgundian, Alemannic and Saxon rolls, and fought as a mix of infantry shield-walls, heavy cavalry and stone-throwers, with grain and baggage moved by ox carts and requisition. The Saxon side was not a state at all but a loose confederation of three adjacent tribes, whose heartland was the belt of marsh, forest and village clearings between the Weser and the Ems; they were led by hereditary tribal nobles who defended their own communities in peacetime and were only united in war by one exile-turned-chieftain. The difference in institutions and religion was part of the conflict itself: the Franks already belonged to the Latin Christian network of bishops and monasteries, while the Saxons maintained their pagan cult centres and local priests, and the quarrel over religion was from the outset one of the pretexts for Frankish war.
people: 關鍵人物集中在法蘭克一側的查理曼（768至814）與薩克森一側的維杜金德（Widukind，約725至807）。查理曼768年即位，771年首次用兵薩克森，在加洛林帝國內他同時面對斯拉夫、保加利亞與阿瓦爾殘部，薩克森戰線只是多線作戰中的一條，此役成功後他才於800年受加冕為皇帝。維杜金德出身奧布特里特貴族，782年集結薩克森與圖林根聯軍兵敗後流亡，785年在阿蒂尼受洗並由查理曼作教父，此後仍於790年與795年兩度起兵，803年在埃姆斯河歸順，是整場戰爭的樞紐。教會方面，烏得勒支主教聖阿馬爾海爾（Amalhair）在785年後主持薩克森傳教，科爾韋、穆爾堡等修道院既是傳教站也是地方治理的支點；法蘭克將領中可確認的有奧特加爾（Otgar of Weimar）與在薩克森任命的伯爵，另有往返談判、主持受洗與監督投降的宮廷使節。史料方面，艾因哈德的《查理曼傳》對薩克森戰事只有概略記述，細節主要出自希因馬主教的書信與早期編年史，這些作者多已無名。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities stand on the two sides of the line: Charlemagne (768 to 814) for the Franks and Widukind (c. 725 to 807) for the Saxons. Charlemagne succeeded to the throne in 768 and first took the field against the Saxons in 771; inside the Carolingian empire he was simultaneously fighting Slavs, Bulgars and the last Avar war, so the Saxon front was only one of several, and it was the success there that led to his imperial coronation in 800. Widukind came from Obotrite nobility; after his combined Saxon and Thuringian coalition was beaten in 782 he went into exile, was baptised at Attigny in 785 with Charlemagne as godfather, yet rose again in 790 and 795, and finally submitted on the Ems in 803, which makes him the hinge of the whole war. On the church side, St Amalhair of Utrecht directed missionary work in Saxony after 785, while monasteries such as Corvey and Münster served both as mission stations and as administrative footholds; among the Frankish commanders named in the sources are Otgar of Weimar and the counts appointed to Saxony, together with envoys who negotiated, presided over baptisms and supervised surrenders. On the documentary side, Einhard's Life of Charlemagne gives only a summary account, and the detail comes chiefly from the letters of Bishop Hincmar and from early annalistic compilations whose authors are mostly unknown by name.
kits: 卡面兵器是秦連弩，即漢代定型的匣式連發弩機：《三國志·諸葛亮傳》載諸葛亮「損益連弩」，《傅子》載曹魏馬鈞改進後可一次蓄五十矢，諸葛亮之弩則有「一發十矢」之說。它把蓄力、扣弦、發射合成一個循環，靠矢匣供箭，射手踩踏或以機架支撐即可連續射出，射程與單兵輸出都遠勝手弓，因此是守城壓制、登城封鎖與野戰齊射的火力節點，在中國漢末三國的野戰中常與長槍方陣、拒馬配合，作用是把遠程打擊的密度拉高到足以遮蔽攻城隊。必須說明的是，這種匣式連弩機在八世紀的西歐並無任何實物或文獻證據，薩克森與法蘭克都沒有弩，一般手弩也要到十世紀才在中世紀西歐重新出現，所以本卡以它代表同類的「儲力連發型投射兵器」在體系中的位置。戰役中真正投入的裝備是：薩克森的短弓、箭約六十至七十厘米、長約兩公尺的白蠓木長矛、單刃約四百克可穿透木盾的投擲斧（francisca）、蒙皮木盾與圓盾、少量皮甲；法蘭克則有帶面甲的頭盔、鎖子甲與札甲、寬身木盾、長矛、斧劍與投石手，成建制重裝騎兵在兩翼展開；攻城方用木製雲梯、撞槌與壕溝障礙，糧食靠牛車與穀物徵發，沼澤地帶的搜索則依賴斥候網與步騎配合。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow, the magazine-fed crossbow that took its final form in the Han: the Records of the Three Kingdoms, biography of Zhuge Liang, note that Zhuge Liang worked on the repeating crossbow, while the Fuzi records that the Wei craftsman Ma Jun improved it so that as many as fifty bolts could be held in one magazine, and Zhuge Liang's version is said to have loosed ten bolts in a single action. It folds drawing, spanning and loosing into a single cycle, feeds bolts from a magazine, and is worked by a tread or rested on a frame so that a single man can shoot continuously, outranging and out-outputting a hand bow by a wide margin; it therefore served as the fire node for defending walls, sealing a breach or covering a line of approach, and in the late Han and Three Kingdoms it was paired with pike formations and chevaux-de-frise to raise the density of missile fire enough to screen a storming column. It has to be said plainly that no physical or textual trace of such a magazine crossbow existed in the eighth-century West: neither Saxons nor Franks had any crossbow at all, and the plain hand crossbow did not return to medieval western Europe until the tenth century, so the card stands for the place in the order of battle occupied by that family of stored-power repeating missile weapons. The equipment actually fielded in this war was: short Saxon bows with arrows of roughly sixty to seventy centimetres, ash lances about two metres long, single-edged throwing axes of about four hundred grams (francisca) capable of biting through wooden shields, hide-covered wooden and round shields, and little body armour; the Franks fielded helmets with face guards, mail and scale, wide wooden shields, lances, axes and swords, with formed heavy cavalry working the flanks; the besiegers used timber scaling ladders, battering rams and ditch obstacles, and grain moved on ox carts under requisition, while searching the marshes relied on a network of scouts working with combined foot and horse.
tactics: 法蘭克方面的戰術核心是「季前推進—殘破鄉野—拉攏堡壘」三段式：每年作戰季多在晚春至初夏，越過萊茵河或沿威悉河河谷北上，先以騎兵斥候網搜出薩克森游擊隊的位置，再以步兵盾牆正面咬住，兩翼騎兵繞擊，並用投石手與弓箭覆蓋隊形空隙。對付游擊的方法不是追求野戰殲滅，而是反覆燒村、砍樹、平田、拆屋，把薩克森人的田產、穀倉、牲口與藏身地系統性摧毀，令游擊隊失去補給，再在威悉河與埃姆斯河沿線修築連續的堡壘線，設立由伯爵常駐的要塞，把鄉村編入法蘭克法下的行政單位，恢復什一稅與教堂網絡。薩克森方面則以拖延與襲擾為主：避免正面會戰，遇敵即退，把法蘭克騎兵引入沼澤、柳林與狹窄村道，藉地形遲滯追兵，趁法蘭克宿營無備夜襲營地；795年法蘭克大軍在埃姆斯河附近遭此類打擊而全軍潰散，營帳與物資盡失，薩克森得以重整。782年聯軍在阿勒河下游被追擊潰散，790年與795年兩度起兵都說明薩克森能以流動戰術拖住帝國正規軍；但帝國可以用年復一年的重複投入抵消這種拖延，薩克森卻無法補充人口、糧食與青壯年。
tacticsEn: The Frankish pattern of operations had three stages: advance at the start of the season, wreck the countryside, then fix the strongholds. Campaigns were fought in late spring and early summer, crossing the Rhine or driving north up the valley of the Weser, and the army began with a screen of mounted scouts to locate the Saxon raiding bands, closed with the infantry shield-wall, sent the heavy cavalry round the flanks and covered the gaps of the formation with stone-throwers and bowmen. The answer to irregular war was not an attempt to annihilate the Saxons in the field but the systematic destruction of their farms, barns, cattle and hiding places by burning villages, felling trees, levelling fields and pulling down houses, so that the raiding bands lost their supplies; then the chain of forts along the Weser and the Ems was reinforced, seats of resident counts were established, the villages were enrolled in Frankish administrative units, and the tithe system and network of churches were restored. The Saxons relied on delay and harassment: they avoided pitched battle, broke off on contact, drew Frankish cavalry into marsh, willow scrub and narrow village lanes, used the ground to slow the pursuit, and struck camps at night while the army slept; in 795 a Frankish host was broken up in this way near the Ems, losing its tents and baggage and leaving the Saxons time to regroup. The defeat of the coalition on the lower Aller in 782 and the risings of 790 and 795 show that the Saxons could hold a regular imperial army at bay with fluid war, but the empire could answer with repeated investment year after year, while the Saxons could not replace the men, the food or the youth that were spent.
data: 可核對的數字有限，而且多出自敵意明顯的法蘭克教會文獻。時間跨度是772年至803年，前後約三十年，編年史把法蘭克的入侵記為八至九次。782年戰敗後遭處決的薩克森人，記載在三千至四千五百之間，其中約三千人是在阿勒河畔的韋爾登被殺，另有數千俘虜被強行遷往法蘭克王國內地，遷徙人數常被記作約七千；790年埃姆斯河之戰後，被處決者又記約一千五百人。795年法蘭克軍的損失沒有確數，編年史只說營地被毀、軍心崩潰。兵員方面沒有可信數字：八世紀法蘭克軍隊是按成年男子徵召的聯隊，具體人數無法考證，也不應把德意志文獻裡的誇張數字當真。地理上，埃姆斯河流程約九百四十公里、威悉河約九百三十公里，兩河之間的沼澤地帶就是薩克森聯盟的核心國土。武器端可引的數字是：馬鈞連弩以五十矢為一夾，諸葛亮之弩有一發十矢之說；薩克森投擲斧單刃約四百克，長矛約兩公尺，箭約六十至七十厘米。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are scarce, and most come from Frankish church sources with an obvious interest in the enemy. The war runs from 772 to 803, roughly thirty years, and the annalists count between eight and nine Frankish invasions. After the defeat of 782 the number of Saxons executed is given at between three thousand and four and a half thousand, of whom about three thousand were killed at Verden on the Aller, while several thousand captives were deported into the interior of the Frankish realm, a figure usually put at about seven thousand; after the battle on the Ems in 790 a further execution of about fifteen hundred men is recorded. The Frankish losses of 795 have no exact figure, the annals saying only that the camp was destroyed and the army demoralised. There is no reliable headcount for the armies: eighth-century Frankish levies were war-bands drawn from the adult males, and their size cannot be reconstructed, nor should the inflated numbers of later German literature be taken at face value. Geographically the Ems runs for about nine hundred and forty kilometres and the Weser for about nine hundred and thirty, and the marshland between them was the core homeland of the Saxon confederation. On the weapons side the quotable numbers are: Ma Jun's repeating crossbow holding fifty bolts in a magazine, Zhuge Liang's engine credited with ten bolts to a shot, Saxon throwing axes of about four hundred grams for the single blade, lances of about two metres, and arrows of roughly sixty to seventy centimetres.
cause: 直接起因在772年：法蘭克王國經過丕平父子兩代的東征，已把疆界推到易北河與威悉河下游，薩克森人控制的河谷地帶正卡在帝國腹地與北方林區之間；薩克森各部族既不交納什一稅，也不接受法蘭克教會在境內設點，庇護從帝國邊境逃亡的抗稅者，還屢次越過威悉河劫掠法蘭克商旅與下游的基督教聚落。查理曼最初只派小股騎兵懲戒，薩克森人則以游擊回應，衝突在數年內升級為全面入侵。深層原因是生存空間與主權：法蘭克的郡縣化、什一稅與傳教士意味著薩克森的土地與信仰都要被重新編排，貴族擔心失去司法傳統與對部眾的領導權；反過來，薩克森方面也明白單靠游擊無法持久，需要一位能統合三族的領袖。782年維杜金德集結薩克森與圖林根聯軍，是把抗爭從邊境騷擾升級為區域性戰爭的關鍵一步。785年受洗之後衝突並未結束，這說明法蘭克以戰逼和換來的只是名義臣服，族群抗爭要等火拼與屠殺都無法再掩飾時才真正收場。
causeEn: The immediate cause lies in 772. After the eastward campaigns of Pippin and his son, the Frankish kingdom had pushed its frontier to the Elbe and the lower Weser, and the Saxon river valleys lay directly between the heart of the empire and the northern woodlands. The Saxon tribes paid no tithe, refused to allow Frankish churches to be established among them, sheltered tax-refusers who fled across the frontier, and repeatedly raided Frankish traders and the Christian settlements of the lower Weser. Charlemagne at first sent only small bodies of horsemen to punish raids, and the Saxons answered with hit-and-run war until the conflict escalated into full invasion within a few years. The deeper cause is survival and sovereignty. Frankish shiring, the tithe and the missionaries meant that Saxon land and Saxon worship were both to be rearranged, and the nobles feared the loss of their customary law and of their grip on the people. In the other direction the Saxons understood that raiding alone could not be sustained and that they needed a leader able to unite the three tribes. The coalition that Widukind assembled from Saxons and Thuringians in 782 was the decisive step that lifted the struggle from frontier harassment to regional war. The fact that fighting continued after the baptism of 785 shows that peace bought by war bought only nominal submission; the tribal struggle ended only when neither further fighting nor further killing could be concealed.
impact: 薩克森戰爭是加洛林時代最徹底、也最具爭議的族群融合案例。直接後果是薩克森的政治自治終結：原有的三族聯盟被拆成若干由法蘭克伯爵治理的區段，貴族可以保留土地，但必須接受法蘭克官吏、修士與主教作為新的中間層；785年以後建立的教區網（烏得勒支、希爾德斯海姆、明斯特）與科爾韋等修道院，把薩克森納入拉丁基督教世界，聖阿馬爾海爾一輩的傳教士在此設立教區學校與什一稅徵收制度。語言與法律層面上，中部德語方言中的薩克森成分由此擴散到威悉河兩側，殘存的薩克森法殘篇顯示薩克森習慣法與法蘭克法長期並行，最後才被合併。軍事上，薩克森的抵抗逼出法蘭克的邊疆常備化：堡壘線、要塞伯爵制、內陸道路與傳令系統成為中世紀領主治理邊疆的原型。長期評價上，韋爾登的屠殺與科爾韋被毀在拉丁文獻中留下的污點，至今仍影響教會史對加洛林王朝的判斷，也使這場戰爭成為「皈依與壓迫」之間那道難以界線的經典案例。
impactEn: The Saxon Wars are the most thorough and most disputed case of tribal assimilation in the Carolingian age. The immediate consequence was the end of Saxon political autonomy: the old confederation of three tribes was broken into districts governed by Frankish counts, and the nobles could keep their lands but had to accept Frankish officials, monks and bishops as a new mediating layer. After 785 the network of dioceses (Utrecht, Hildesheim, Münster) and monasteries such as Corvey drew Saxony into the Latin Christian world, and missionaries of the stamp of St Amalhair set up cathedral schools and the machinery of the tithe. Linguistically and legally, the Saxon element in the central German dialects spread on both sides of the Weser, while the surviving fragments of Saxon law show customary Saxon law running in parallel with Frankish law for a long time before the two were merged. Militarily, Saxon resistance forced the Frankish frontier to become permanently garrisoned: the chain of forts, the system of counts resident in strongholds, the inland roads and the message system all became the prototype for medieval lordly frontier government. In the long run, the stain left by the executions at Verden and the destruction of Corvey in the Latin sources still colours how church historians judge the Carolingian dynasty, and the war remains the classic case of the line that cannot easily be drawn between conversion and coercion.
result: 803年，維杜金德在埃姆斯河向法蘭克歸順並接受基督教，薩克森戰爭以法蘭克全面勝利告終。此後他的行止只餘零星記載，一般認為他退隱到比薩松一帶的莊園，約807年去世；薩克森地區被改為由法蘭克伯爵治理的行政區，傳教網絡完成最後一段鋪設，貴族多在受洗的前提下保留莊園與私人武力，同時被要求交納什一稅、維持教會修復並在戰事中提供兵役，這種雙重身份延續到九世紀，並在奧托王朝時期演成薩克森公國。武器技術的結論更值得記住：八世紀末的西歐戰場仍以弓、長矛、投擲斧與盾牆為主，普通手弩要到十世紀才重新出現並在十一世紀大行其道，而匣式連弩機從未進入中世紀歐洲，它在中國東漢至三國定型之後，只在亞洲與西亞各自演化成別的樣子。卡面秦連弩因此代表的是一條與薩克森戰爭毫無交集的技術譜系：它說明加洛林時代真正缺少的是可連續射擊的投射火力，而不是更多的人口。
resultEn: In 803 Widukind submitted to the Franks on the Ems and accepted Christianity, and the Saxon Wars ended in a complete Frankish victory. Only fragmentary traces of his later movements survive, and he is generally held to have retired to an estate in the Biscion area, dying around 807. The Saxon land was turned into districts administered by Frankish counts, the missionary network was completed, and the nobles kept their estates and their private armed following on condition of baptism, while being bound to pay the tithe, to maintain the restored churches and to furnish troops for war; this double status lasted into the ninth century and, under the Ottonians, grew into the duchy of Saxony. The conclusion about weapons is more worth remembering. On late eighth-century western European battlefields the bow, the lance, the throwing axe and the shield-wall still carried the day; the plain hand crossbow did not return until the tenth century and did not spread widely until the eleventh; and the magazine-fed repeating crossbow never entered medieval Europe at all, taking its final form in the Han and Three Kingdoms in China and then developing along separate lines in Asia and in West Asia. The Qin repeating crossbow on the card thus stands for a line of development with no overlap at all with the Saxon Wars: it records what the Carolingian age genuinely lacked, which was not more manpower but missile fire that could be delivered continuously.
